about.description: Discover the hand-dyeing and block-printing craft behind Bharathi Prints sarees.
about.title: A saree as individual as the woman who wears it.
about.introduction: At Bharathi Prints, we are dedicated saree manufacturers rooted in the timeless traditions of hand-dyeing and block printing. Every fabric begins as a blank canvas and evolves into a one-of-one wearable piece of art.
about.craftTitle: Our craft: the art of one-of-one
about.craftIntroduction: Unlike mass-produced textiles, no two creations at Bharathi Prints are ever identical. From selecting raw fabrics to mixing custom dye vats and hand-stamping intricate wooden blocks, we take complete creative ownership of our process.

craft.title: Bespoke hand-dyeing
craft.description: We dye our fabrics in small, carefully curated batches, experimenting with rich hues, earthy tones, and bespoke color combinations chosen in-house by our artisans.

craft.title: Intricate block printing
craft.description: Using hand-carved wooden blocks, each motif is stamped by hand with precision and patience. Subtle variations in pressure and dye absorption are the hallmark of authentic craftsmanship, giving every saree a character machines can never replicate.

craft.title: Truly one of a kind
craft.description: We design, dye, and print according to our own artistic instincts rather than rigid templates. Every saree that leaves our workshop is a singular edition; once a piece is draped, there is never another quite like it.

about.philosophy: Fashion moves fast, but true craftsmanship endures. At Bharathi Prints, we honor slow, intentional manufacturing and celebrate the human touch behind every thread, color, and motif.
about.closingStatement: When you choose a Bharathi Prints saree, you are not just buying a garment; you are owning an original piece of textile artistry made exclusively for you.

contact.description: Get personal help with saree availability, fabric videos, orders, and shipping from Bharathi Prints.
contact.title: Let’s find your one-of-one drape.
contact.introduction: We’d love to hear from you! Because every Bharathi Prints saree is a one-of-one creation, pieces move quickly. We’re always happy to help you find the right drape, share close-up videos of available stock, or answer questions about our hand-dyed fabrics.
contact.whatsappDescription: Chat with us for instant availability checks, fabric details, and order inquiries.

helpItems.title: Check saree availability
helpItems.description: Spotted a saree on our YouTube channel (@bharathiprints) or in our catalog? Send us its Product ID (for example, SR-1042) to check availability or reserve it before it’s gone.

helpItems.title: Request fabric videos
helpItems.description: Want to see how a specific hand-dyed cotton drape looks in natural daylight? Reach out on WhatsApp and we’ll share a quick video.

helpItems.title: Order & shipping support
helpItems.description: Need an update on a dispatched parcel or help with delivery anywhere in India? Message us with your order details.
